perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: September 18 FDA approval of Inluriyo with Verzenio remains the newest realized primary regulatory signal.

Independent September 14 reporting says Foundayo captured over 30% of new U.S. oral weight-loss patients, an early commercial-adoption signal that is materially different from the prior regulatory evidence.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Regulatory conversion plus early oral-obesity share supports execution breadth, but early new-patient share is not equivalent to durable market share, revenue or margin.

lineage.searchStrategy: cumulative primary reuse plus materially different independent commercial-adoption evidence
